prompts.title: 渐变背景的情绪网格
prompts.description: 一个用于生成多面板网格（7 个面板）的提示，展示不同情绪（喜悦、震惊、严肃、深情、自信、友好、悲伤），并以相应的彩色渐变背景衬托，同时包含每个面板的布局和视觉细节的具体说明。
prompts.content:
Panels are NOT edge-to-edge
Visible thin white spacing between panels Subtle outer white margin around the entire grid clean modern UI-style layout
Slight rounded corners on each tile
Panel 1 — Joyful / Celebratory (Yellow) Bright yellow gradient background
Arms raised
Eyes closed
Big open laugh
Energetic posture
Panel 2 — Shocked (Blue)
Blue gradient background
Hands on cheeks
Wide eyes
Open mouth
Raised brows
Panel 3 — Serious / Stern (Red)
Red background
Arms crossed
Furrowed brows
Neutral tight lips
Wearing dark hoodie
Panel 4 — Affectionate (Pink)
Soft pink gradient
Holding small brown puppy
Gentle smile
Cozy knit sweater
Panel 5 — Confident / Sassy (Purple)
Purple gradient background
One hand on hip
Slight smirk
Graphic t-shirt
Relaxed stance
Panel 6 — Friendly / Casual Approval (Green)
Green gradient background
Wearing cap + denim jacket
Thumbs-up
Relaxed smile
Panel 7 — Sad / Emotional (Gray)
Gray gradient background
Slight downward gaze
Eyebrows slightly raised in center
Lips slightly curved downward

红色背景
双臂交叉

面板 4 — 亲昵（粉色）

prompts.content: Masterpiece, 8K, UHD, cinematic portrait, a stylish man (completely identical to the reference image), standing confidently against a modern architectural wall with large sleek tiles. His face and hairstyle are perfectly matched to the reference. He wears a gradient sweatshirt (soft light gray at top to deep black at bottom), loose black pants, dark sunglasses rectangular shape, and a smartwatch on his left wrist. Reflective glass windows, subtle urban elements, distant buildings, street textures. Ambient natural daylight, soft shadows and highlights enhancing facial features, fabric textures, and glass reflections. Sharp focus, shallow depth of field, ultra-realistic, lifelike skin tones, high dynamic range, fashion photoshoot, contemporary city vibe.

prompts.title: 高保真夜间海港闪光照片
prompts.description: 这是一个极其详细的提示，用于生成一张高保真原始照片，模拟 iPhone 17 Pro 在夜间码头使用闪光灯拍摄的效果。它基于提供的自拍照进行严格的身份锁定，并指定了姿势（低蹲）、服装（灰色罗纹针织迷你连衣裙、及膝长靴）、灯光（刺眼的直射闪光）和环境（黑暗的水面、石砖）等精确细节。
prompts.content:
(9:16) Raw high-fidelity photo, high-angle medium shot. iPhone 17 Pro simulation, 24mm wide-angle, f/2.8, sharp subject focus, authentic digital grain.

Scene: Subject fills ~65% of frame in crouching/kneeling pose. Upper 40% shows pitch-black night sky and dark marina water; lower 20% textured stone tile floor. Camera ~1.5m above subject angled downward.

Identity Lock: Inherit ALL facial features from the provided selfie (face shape, bone structure, eyes, nose, lips, skin tone, hair).

Photogenic Enhancements: Natural skin clarity with preserved texture, even tone, subtle luminosity, refined jawline shadows, gentle nasal highlight, soft cheekbone highlights, enhanced iris catchlights, natural lash separation, groomed brows, pearl-white teeth, salon-finish hair with controlled flyaways. Bio-fidelity with micro-pores, hydrated T-zone, faint vellus hair.

Expression: Pensive neutral look. Gaze ~45° to mid-right off-camera. Slightly parted lips, relaxed brows, head tilted slightly right.

Hair: Inherit color/texture from selfie. Long sleek straight hair with center part falling behind shoulders. Strong flash highlights creating strand separation.

Makeup: Glossy pink lips, clean foundation, winged black eyeliner, defined lashes, soft blush.

Accessories: Thin gold chain necklace with small heart pendant, crystal-studded silver strap across left shoulder, gold bracelets/watch on left wrist.

Outfit: Light grey rib-knit off-shoulder mini dress with long sleeves. White floral-lace tights. Dark slate-grey suede thigh-high boots. Realistic fabric tension and elbow/waist bunching; detailed lace skin interaction. Defined S-curve silhouette with enhanced waist–hip and leg geometry.

Pose: Torso and hips angled ~45° right. Head turned further right, looking off-camera. Low crouch on stone floor, arms relaxed forward with natural finger articulation.

Mood: Moody urban nighttime aesthetic. Palette: slate grey, optic white, onyx black, pale gold.

Lighting: Harsh direct flash (~6500K) from camera, bright skin highlights and deep shadows. High-contrast flash photography look.

Environment: Night marina/waterfront — dark water with vertical dock light reflections, blurred white yacht mid-left, large textured grey stone tiles underfoot. Sharp subject shadows anchor to the ground.
prompts.translatedContent:
(9:16) 原始高保真照片，高角度中景。iPhone 17 Pro 模拟，24mm 广角，f/2.8，主体对焦锐利，真实的数字颗粒感。

场景：主体以蹲伏/跪姿占据画面约 65%。上方 40% 为漆黑的夜空和幽暗的码头水面；下方 20% 为有纹理的石砖地面。相机位于主体上方约 1.5 米处，向下倾斜。

身份锁定：继承所提供自拍中的所有面部特征（脸型、骨骼结构、眼睛、鼻子、嘴唇、肤色、头发）。

上镜增强：自然清透的肌肤，保留纹理，肤色均匀，微妙的光泽感，精致的下颌线阴影，柔和的鼻部高光，柔美的颧骨高光，增强的虹膜眼神光，自然的睫毛分离，修饰过的眉毛，珍珠白牙齿，沙龙级发型，发丝服帖。生物保真度，包括微孔、水润的 T 区、细微的汗毛。

表情：沉思的中性表情。目光向右前方偏离镜头约 45°。嘴唇微张，眉毛放松，头部略微向右倾斜。

发型：继承自拍中的发色/发质。长而顺滑的直发，中分，垂在肩后。强烈的闪光灯高光营造出发丝分离感。

妆容：亮粉色唇彩，清透底妆，黑色上扬眼线，分明的睫毛，柔和腮红。

配饰：细金链项链，带小爱心吊坠；左肩佩戴镶水晶银色肩带；左手腕佩戴金色手链/手表。

服装：浅灰色罗纹针织露肩迷你连衣裙，长袖。白色花卉蕾丝连裤袜。深石板灰色麂皮过膝靴。逼真的面料张力，肘部/腰部褶皱；精致的蕾丝与皮肤互动。清晰的 S 形轮廓，增强腰臀和腿部几何感。

姿势：躯干和臀部向右倾斜约 45°。头部进一步向右转，看向镜头外。低姿蹲伏在石砖地面上，双臂自然放松向前，手指关节自然。

氛围：都市夜景的忧郁美学。调色板：石板灰、光学白、玛瑙黑、淡金色。

灯光：相机发出刺眼的直射闪光灯（约 6500K），皮肤高光明亮，阴影深邃。高对比度闪光摄影效果。

环境：夜间码头/海滨——黑暗的水面，有垂直的码头灯光倒影，左中位置模糊的白色游艇，脚下是大型有纹理的灰色石砖。锐利的主体阴影固定在地面上。

prompts.description: 一个复杂的提示，用于生成一张超现实主义全身照片，照片中包含用户的肖像和他们自己的 Q 版动漫形象，并叠加 Apple Music 播放器 UI 界面，强调高对比度、特定服装以及图形元素的干净整合。
prompts.content: Create an Ultra-detailed, ratio 4:5, hyperrealistic full-body photograph of a stylish me posing on a modern city sidewalk under bright, direct midday sun. The composition is a vertical medium-full shot from an eye-level perspective. The me leans casually against a dark grey metal street pole that creates a strong vertical line just right of center. He wears a striking, slightly glossy crimson red faux leather jacket zipped halfway over a crisp white collared shirt. His trousers are wide-leg, cream-colored corduroy with visible texture. He wears polished black leather loafers. His pose is relaxed, with one leg crossed over the other, and his left hand is tucked into his pocket. He has curly black hair and wears modern black-framed glasses, looking off to his right with a neutral, cool expression. To his right, a cute chibi anime character version of himself, with a large head and big eyes, perfectly mirrors his pose and outfit, rendered with clean black line art and simple cell shading. On the left side of the frame, a large, semi-transparent, dark grey, rounded rectangle overlay mimicking an Apple Music player Ul is professionally superimposed, featuring album art of a red canoe on water and playback controls; this Ul has a subtle 'glassmorphism' frosted glass effect. The lighting is hard sunlight from the top-right, casting sharp, defined shadows on the light grey tiled pavement. The background consists of a modern building with large, greenish-tinted glass panels. Shot with a 35mm lens, f/5.6 aperture, creating sharp focus on the subject and graphics with a slightly soft background. The color science emphasizes high contrast between the crimson red, cream, and cool tones of the environment. Avoid any motion blur, unnatural skin textures, or distorted proportions. The integration of the graphic elements must be seamless and clean, without pixelation or rough edges.
prompts.translatedContent: 创作一张超细节、比例为 4:5 的超现实全身照片，照片中的我时尚地摆姿势，站在现代城市人行道上，在明亮、直射的正午阳光下。构图是垂直的中全景，视角与视线齐平。我随意地靠在一根深灰色金属路灯杆上，路灯杆在画面中心偏右的位置形成一道强烈的垂直线条。我穿着一件醒目、略带光泽的深红色仿皮夹克，拉链拉到一半，内搭一件挺括的白色翻领衬衫。我的裤子是阔腿的米色灯芯绒裤，纹理清晰可见。我穿着擦亮的黑色皮乐福鞋。我的姿势放松，一条腿搭在另一条腿上，左手插在口袋里。我有一头卷曲的黑发，戴着现代的黑框眼镜，目光望向右侧，表情中性而酷。在我的右侧，一个可爱的 Q 版动漫角色版本的我，有着大大的头和眼睛，完美地模仿了我的姿势和服装，以简洁的黑色线条艺术和简单的赛璐珞着色呈现。在画面左侧，一个大型、半透明、深灰色、圆角矩形叠加层，模仿 Apple Music 播放器 UI，专业地叠加在画面上，上面有红色独木舟在水上的专辑封面和播放控制；这个 UI 具有微妙的“玻璃拟态”磨砂玻璃效果。光线是来自右上方的强烈阳光，在浅灰色瓷砖路面上投射出锐利、清晰的阴影。背景是一栋带有大型、泛绿玻璃幕墙的现代建筑。使用 35mm 镜头拍摄，f/5.6 光圈，使主体和图形清晰对焦，背景略微柔和。色彩科学强调深红色、米色和环境冷色调之间的高对比度。避免任何运动模糊、不自然的皮肤纹理或扭曲的比例。图形元素的整合必须无缝且干净，没有像素化或粗糙的边缘。
